title.zh: 卷十七 本紀第十七 哲宗一
title.raw: 卷十七 本紀第十七 哲宗一 Volume 17 Annals 17: Zhezong 1

sentences.zh: 哲宗憲元繼道顯德定功欽文睿武齊聖昭孝皇帝，諱煦，神宗第六子也，母曰欽聖皇后朱氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhezong Xianyuan Jidao Xiande Dinggong Qinwen Ruiwu Qisheng Zhaoxiao, taboo name Xu, was the sixth son of Emperor Shenzong; his mother was Empress Xinsheng, née Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhezong—posthumous Xianyuan through Zhaoxiao—taboo name Xu, Shenzong’s sixth son, born of Empress Xinsheng Zhu.

sentences.zh: 熙寧九年十二月七日己丑生於宮中，赤光照室。

translations.literal: Ninth year of Xining, twelfth month, seventh day, day jichou: born in the palace; red light filled the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 9, twelfth month, day 7 jichou: he was born in the palace under a red glow that filled the room.

sentences.zh: 初名傭，授檢校太尉、天平軍節度使，封均國公。

translations.literal: Initially named Yong; appointed Honorary Grand Marshal and military commissioner of Tianping; enfeoffed Duke of Jun.
translations.idiomatic: First named Yong, he received honorary grand marshal rank, Tianping command, and the title Duke of Jun.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年，遷開府儀同三司、彰武軍節度使，進封延安郡王。

translations.literal: Fifth year of Yuanfeng: promoted to open-folder parity with triple grandees and military commissioner of Zhangwu; advanced to Prince of Yan’an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfeng 5: he rose to open-folder grandee, Zhangwu commissioner, and Prince of Yan’an.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，神宗宴群臣于集英殿，王侍立，天表粹溫，進止中度，宰相而下再拜賀。

translations.literal: Third month, year seven: Shenzong feasted officials at Jiying Hall; the prince stood in attendance—his bearing pure and mild, his movements measured—and from the chief minister down all bowed twice in congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfeng 7, third month: at a Jiying feast the prince stood by—comely, measured—and ministers bowed twice in praise.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，神宗寢疾，宰相王珪乞早建儲，爲宗廟社稷計，又奏請皇太后權同聽政，神宗首肯。

translations.literal: Second month, year eight: Shenzong lay ill; chief minister Wang Gui asked that the heir be established early for temple and altars, and also memorialized that the empress dowager jointly exercise regency—Shenzong assented.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfeng 8, second month: as Shenzong sickened, Wang Gui urged early investiture and regency for the empress dowager; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午朔，皇太后垂簾于福寧殿，諭珪等曰：「皇子性莊重，從學穎悟。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiawu new moon: the empress dowager held court behind the curtain at Funing Hall and told Gui and the others: “The prince’s nature is grave and steady, and he is quick in study.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiawu new moon: at Funing the empress dowager ruled from behind the curtain and told Gui’s party, “The prince is grave and quick to learn.

sentences.zh: 自皇帝服藥，手寫佛書，爲帝祈福。

translations.literal: Since the emperor took medicine, he has copied Buddhist scriptures by hand to pray for the emperor’s blessing.”
translations.idiomatic: Since the emperor fell ill he has copied sutras by hand to pray for him.”

sentences.zh: 」因出以示珪等，所書字極端謹，珪等稱賀，遂奉制立爲皇太子。

translations.literal: She then produced them for Gui and the others—the characters extremely careful and correct; Gui and the others offered congratulations, and by imperial order he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: She showed the copies—each stroke meticulous—and Gui’s party congratulated him; an order then made him crown prince.

sentences.zh: 初，太子宮中常有赤光，至是光益熾如火。

translations.literal: Earlier, red light had often appeared in the crown prince’s quarters; now the light blazed like fire.
translations.idiomatic: Red light had long haunted the heir’s halls; now it burned like flame.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，神宗崩，太子即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Shenzong died; the crown prince took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Shenzong died and the heir ascended.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大赦天下常赦所不原者。

translations.literal: Day jihai: a great amnesty for the empire, including those not normally pardoned by routine amnesties.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the throne proclaimed amnesty even for crimes routine pardons excluded.

sentences.zh: 群臣進秩，賜賚諸軍。

translations.literal: Officials were advanced in rank; rewards were granted to the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers rose in rank and the armies received bounty.

sentences.zh: 遣使告哀於遼。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Messengers carried word of mourning to Liao.

sentences.zh: 白虹貫日。

translations.literal: A white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚子，尊皇太后曰太皇太后，皇后曰皇太后，德妃朱氏曰皇太妃。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the empress dowager was honored as grand empress dowager; the empress as empress dowager; the Virtuous Consort Zhu as imperial consort mother.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the empress dowager became grand empress dowager, the empress empress dowager, and Virtuous Consort Zhu imperial consort mother.

sentences.zh: 命宰臣王珪爲山陵使。

translations.literal: Chief minister Wang Gui was appointed mausoleum commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui was named mausoleum commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以群臣固請，始同太皇太后聽政。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: at the officials’ repeated request, he began to attend to government together with the grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, pressed by the court, he began to govern with Grand Empress Dowager Gao.

sentences.zh: 己未，賜叔雍王顥、曹王頵贊拜不名。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: his uncles Prince Yong Hao and Prince of Cao Juan were granted the privilege of bowing without having their names called.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, his uncles Hao of Yong and Juan of Cao won the bow-without-naming privilege.

sentences.zh: 令中外避太皇太后父遵甫名。

translations.literal: Inside and outside the court were ordered to avoid the name Zunfu, father of the grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was ordered to taboo the name Zunfu, the grand empress dowager’s father.

sentences.zh: 詔邊事稍重者，樞密院與三省同議以進。

translations.literal: Edict: on border matters of some weight, the Military Affairs Bureau and the Three Departments were to deliberate together before memorializing.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered weightier border business to be debated by the Military Affairs Bureau and Three Departments before submission.

sentences.zh: 庚申，尚書左僕射、郇國公王珪進封岐國公。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Duke of Xun Wang Gui was advanced to Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Gui of Xun rose to Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 顥進封揚王，頵爲荊王，並加太保。

translations.literal: Hao was advanced to Prince of Yang; Juan was made Prince of Jing; both were made grand guardians.
translations.idiomatic: Hao became Prince of Yang and Juan Prince of Jing, both grand guardians.

sentences.zh: 弟甯國公佶爲遂甯郡王，儀國公佖爲太甯郡王，成國公俁爲咸甯郡王，和國公似爲普甯郡王。

translations.literal: His younger brothers Duke of Ning Ji became Prince of Suining commandery; Duke of Yi Bian Prince of Taining; Duke of Cheng Yu Prince of Xianning; Duke of He Si Prince of Puning.
translations.idiomatic: Brothers Ji, Bian, Yu, and Si rose from ducal to commandery princes of Suining, Taining, Xianning, and Puning.

sentences.zh: 高密郡王宗晟、漢東郡王宗瑗、華原郡王宗愈、安康郡王宗隱、建安郡王宗綽並爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Princes Zongcheng of Gaomi, Zongyuan of Handong, Zongyu of Huayuan, Zongyin of Ankang, and Zongchuo of Jian’an were all made open-folder parity with triple grandees.
translations.idiomatic: Zongcheng, Zongyuan, Zongyu, Zongyin, and Zongchuo each received open-folder grandee rank.

sentences.zh: 太師、潞國公文彥博爲司徒，濟陽郡王曹佾爲太保，特進王安石爲司空，餘進秩，賜致仕服帶、銀帛有差。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor and Duke of Lu Wen Yanbo became Minister of Education; Prince of Jiyang Cao Yi grand guardian; specially advanced Wang Anshi Minister of Works; the rest were advanced; retired officials received belts, silver, and silks in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo became minister of education, Cao Yi grand guardian, Wang Anshi minister of works, others were promoted, and retirees got belts, silver, and silk by degree.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔顏子、孟子配享孔子廟庭。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: edict that Yan Hui and Mencius be granted sacrificial shares in the Confucian temple court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yan Hui and Mencius were paired with Confucius in the temple.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，初御紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingyin: for the first time he held court in Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, bingyin: he first held audience in Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛未，蠲元豐六年以前逋賦。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: arrears in taxes before the sixth year of Yuanfeng were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, tax arrears before Yuanfeng 6 were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，加李乾德同中書門下平章事，董氈檢校太尉。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Li Qiande was given the title co-signer of the Secretariat and Chancellery; Dong Zhan honorary grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Li Qiande became co-signer and Dong Zhan honorary grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「先皇帝臨御十有九年，建立政事以澤天下，而有司奉行失當，幾於煩擾，或苟且文具，不能布宣實惠。

translations.literal: Edict: “The late emperor ruled for nineteen years, establishing government to bless the realm, yet the offices carried it out wrongly, nearly to vexation, or were perfunctory on paper and could not spread real benefit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled Shenzong’s nineteen-year rule and blamed clerks for vexing, paper-bound execution that never reached the people.

sentences.zh: 其申諭中外，協心奉令，以稱先帝惠安元元之意。

translations.literal: Proclaim this inside and outside: unite in obeying orders, to match the late emperor’s intent to comfort the masses.”
translations.idiomatic: The court and provinces were told to obey in earnest, matching Shenzong’s wish to ease the common people.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，詔乙太皇太后生日爲坤成節。

translations.literal: Day yihai: edict that the second yi day of the grand empress dowager’s birthday be the Kuncheng festival.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, her birthday’s second yi day became the Kuncheng festival.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召呂公著侍讀。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Lü Gongzhu was summoned as lecturer-in-attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Lü Gongzhu was called to lecture at court.

sentences.zh: 諭樞密、中書通議事都堂。

translations.literal: The Military Affairs Bureau and Secretariat-Chancellery were ordered to discuss affairs jointly at the chief ministers’ hall.
translations.idiomatic: Military Affairs and the Secretariat-Chancellery were told to meet at the chief ministers’ hall.

sentences.zh: 詔遵先帝制，遣官察舉諸路監司之法。

translations.literal: Edict: following the late emperor’s system, officials were sent to investigate circuit supervisors by law.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors were again dispatched to review circuit commissioners, as under Shenzong.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，呂惠卿遣兵入西界，破六砦，斬首六百餘級。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Lü Huiqing sent troops into the western borderlands, took six forts, and beheaded more than six hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Lü Huiqing crossed the western border, seized six forts, and took six hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 辛己，遣使以先帝遺留物遺遼國及告即位，甲申，水部員外郎王諤非職言事，坐罰金。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: envoys were sent with the late emperor’s bequests to Liao and to announce the accession; day jiashen, Water Ministry vice director Wang E memorialized outside his duty and was fined.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, gifts and accession word went to Liao; on jiashen, Wang E was fined for an out-of-role memorial.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以蕃官高福戰死，錄其子孫。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: because the tribal officer Gao Fu died in battle, his sons and grandsons were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Gao Fu’s line was rewarded after he fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復蠲舊年逋賦。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: arrears in taxes from former years were again remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, old tax arrears were forgiven again.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，賜楚州孝子徐積絹米。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengwu: the filial son Xu Ji of Chuzhou was granted silk and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengwu: Xu Ji of Chuzhou, noted for filial piety, received silk and rice.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔中外臣庶許直言朝政闕失、民間疾苦。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: edict that civil and military officials inside and outside might speak frankly on court lapses and popular hardship.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, all officials were invited to report court failures and folk suffering plainly.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，以資政殿大學士呂公著爲尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuxu: Palace Political Affairs academician Lü Gongzhu was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuxu: Lü Gongzhu became left vice director of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔府界、三路保甲罷團教。

translations.literal: Edict: in the capital circuit and the Three Routes, baojia group drilling was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Group baojia drill was ended in the capital circuit and the Three Routes.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遼人來弔祭。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Liao envoys came to mourn.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Liao sent mourners.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎熊本奏歸化儂智會異同，坐罰金。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Xiong Ben memorialized on the agreement and disagreement over the Guihua chieftain Nong Zhihui and was fined.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Ben was fined over a memorial on Guihua chief Nong Zhihui.

sentences.zh: 罷沅州增修堡砦。

translations.literal: Construction of additional forts at Yuan prefecture was halted.
translations.idiomatic: New fort building at Yuanzhou was stopped.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，詔按察官所至，有才能顯著者以名聞。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yichou: edict that wherever investigating commissioners arrived, men of outstanding talent were to be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yichou: investigators were to name able men they found.

sentences.zh: 己巳，鎮江軍節度使韓絳進開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Zhenjiang army military commissioner Han Jiang was advanced to open-folder parity with triple grandees.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Han Jiang of Zhenjiang became an open-folder grandee.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣使賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: envoys were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler’s birthday and New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, a mission wished Liao birthday and New Year.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以供奉王英戰死葭蘆，錄其子。

translations.literal: Day yihai: because the attendant Wang Ying died in battle at Jialu, his sons were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wang Ying’s sons were rewarded after he fell at Jialu.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，以神宗英文烈武聖孝皇帝之諡告於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuxu: the posthumous title of Emperor Shenzong Yingwen Liewu Shengxiao was announced to Heaven, Earth, the Ancestral Temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuxu: Shenzong’s posthumous title Yingwen Liewu Shengxiao was proclaimed to heaven, earth, temple, and altars.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上寶冊于福寧殿。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the precious registers were presented at Funing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the imperial registers were offered at Funing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣使報謝於遼。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: envoys were sent to Liao with thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, envoys carried thanks to Liao.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，夏國遣使進助山陵馬。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiazi: Western Xia sent envoys presenting horses to assist the mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiazi: Xia sent horses for the burial.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔仿《唐六典》置諫官。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: edict to establish remonstrance officials modeled on the Tang Six Canons.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, remonstrance posts were set up after the Tang Six Canons.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，令侍從各舉諫官二人。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: attendants-in-waiting were each ordered to recommend two remonstrance officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, each attendant was to name two remonstrance candidates.

sentences.zh: 詔監察御史兼言事，殿中侍御史兼察事。

translations.literal: Edict: surveillance censors were additionally charged with remonstrance; palace censors additionally with investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance censors gained remonstrance duties; palace censors gained investigation duties.

sentences.zh: 罷義倉。

translations.literal: The charity granaries were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The charity granary system was ended.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔均寬民力，有司或致廢格者，監司、御史糾劾之。

translations.literal: Day jimao: edict to equalize and ease the people’s burden; where offices caused rules to lapse, circuit supervisors and censors were to impeach.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, burdens were to be eased and censors were to punish officials who let relief rules die.

sentences.zh: 河決大名。

translations.literal: The Yellow River breached at Daming.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke through at Daming.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，葬神宗皇帝于永裕陵。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Emperor Shenzong was buried at Yongyu mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Shenzong was interred at Yongyu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，罷方田。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the square-field system was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the square-field system was ended.

sentences.zh: 以夏國主母卒，遣使弔祭。

translations.literal: Because the Western Xia ruler’s mother died, envoys were sent to mourn.
translations.idiomatic: Messengers mourned the death of the Xia ruler’s mother.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年春正月庚寅朔，改元。

translations.literal: First year of Yuanyou, spring, first month, day gengyin new moon: the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou 1, spring, gengyin new moon: the reign title changed to Yuanyou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，錄在京囚，減死罪以下一等，杖罪者釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: prisoners in the capital were reviewed; below death penalty one degree was reduced; those with beating penalties were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, capital sentences were lightened one grade and beating punishments were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔回賜高麗王鞍馬、服帶、器幣有加。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: edict to increase the return gifts to the king of Goryeo in saddles, horses, belts, and vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, return gifts to the Goryeo king in horses, belts, and goods were enlarged.

sentences.zh: 罷陝西、河東元豐四年後凡緣軍興添置官局。

translations.literal: Offices added after the fourth year of Yuanfeng for military reasons in Shaanxi and Hedong were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: War-time offices set up after Yuanfeng 4 in Shaanxi and Hedong were dismantled.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，久旱，幸相國寺祈雨。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: after long drought, he visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, after prolonged drought he prayed for rain at Xiangguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 立神宗原廟。

translations.literal: Shenzong’s original temple was established.
translations.idiomatic: A temple for Shenzong was founded.

sentences.zh: 戊午，甘露降。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: sweet dew descended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, sweet dew fell.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，以河決大名，壞民田，民艱食者衆，詔安撫使韓絳振之。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinyou: because the Yellow River breached at Daming and ruined fields, and many people lacked food, edict that pacification commissioner Han Jiang relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinyou: after the Daming breach left fields ruined and people hungry, Han Jiang was sent to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，修《神宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Veritable Records of Shenzong were compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, work began on Shenzong’s Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔左右侍從各舉堪任監司者二人，舉非其人有罰。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: edict that left and right attendants each recommend two men fit for circuit supervision, with penalties if the choice was wrong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, attendants were each to name two fit circuit commissioners, with punishment for bad picks.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禁邊民與夏人爲市。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: border people were forbidden to trade with Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, frontier trade with Xia was banned.

sentences.zh: 辛未，董氈卒，以其子阿里骨襲河西軍節度使、邈川首領。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Dong Zhan died; his son Aligu succeeded as military commissioner of Hexi and chief of Miaochuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Dong Zhan died and his son Aligu took Hexi command and Miaochuan leadership.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，夏人入貢。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Xia presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，刑部侍郎蹇周輔坐變鹽法落職。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Vice Minister of Punishments Jian Zhoufu was dismissed for altering the salt law.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Jian Zhoufu lost office for changing the salt law.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚寅，蔡確罷。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day gengyin: Cai Que was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, gengyin: Cai Que left office.

sentences.zh: 以司馬光爲尚書左僕射、門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Sima Guang was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang became left vice director and vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 詔韓維、呂大防、孫永、范純仁詳定役法。

translations.literal: Edict that Han Wei, Lü Dafang, Sun Yong, and Fan Chunren thoroughly fix the labor-service law.
translations.idiomatic: Han Wei, Lü Dafang, Sun Yong, and Fan Chunren were ordered to revise the labor-service law.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以呂公著爲門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Lü Gongzhu was made Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Lü Gongzhu became vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，守尚書右丞李清臣爲尚書左丞，試吏部尚書呂大防爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: acting Right Vice Director Li Qingchen was made Left Vice Director; acting Minister of Personnel Lü Dafang was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Li Qingchen moved to left vice director and Lü Dafang to right vice director.

sentences.zh: 白虹貫日。

translations.literal: A white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁未，群臣上太皇太后宮名曰崇慶，殿曰崇慶壽康；

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the officials presented the grand empress dowager’s palace name Chongqing and hall name Chongqing Shoukang;
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the court named Grand Empress Dowager Gao’s palace Chongqing and its hall Chongqing Shoukang;

sentences.zh: 皇太后宮曰隆祐，殿曰隆祐慈徽。

translations.literal: the empress dowager’s palace name Longyou and hall name Longyou Cihui.
translations.idiomatic: the empress dowager’s palace Longyou and hall Longyou Cihui.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賜于闐國王服帶、器幣。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the king of Khotan was granted belts and vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Khotan’s king received belts and ritual goods.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，章惇罷。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhang Dun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhang Dun left office.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔侍從、御史、國子司業各舉經明行修、可爲學官者二人。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: edict that attendants-in-waiting, censors, and National University vice presidents each recommend two men of classic learning and upright conduct fit to be instructors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, attendants, censors, and university officers were each to name two learned, upright men for teaching posts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以吏部尚書范純仁同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Minister of Personnel Fan Chunren was made Associate Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Fan Chunren joined the military commission as associate commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，掩京城暴骸。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: exposed corpses in the capital were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, unburied dead in the capital were interred.

sentences.zh: 罷諸州常平管勾官。

translations.literal: The ever-normal granary supervisory posts in all prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Ever-normal granary overseers were removed from every prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，詔毋以堂差沖在選已注官。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinwei: edict that hall appointments must not displace registered selectees.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinwei: patronage posts could no longer bump registered appointees.

sentences.zh: 置訴理所，許熙寧以來得罪者自言。

translations.literal: A Petition Review Office was established; those punished since Xining might plead their cases.
translations.idiomatic: A Petition Review Office let those punished since Xining appeal.

sentences.zh: 命太學公試，司業、博士主之，如春秋補試法。

translations.literal: The Imperial University public examination was ordered; the vice president and doctors presided, as in the spring supplementary examination law.
translations.idiomatic: The university held a public exam under its vice president and doctors, by the spring supplement rule.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，置開封府界提點刑獄一員。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: one post of judicial intendant for the Kaifeng metropolitan circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Kaifeng gained a judicial intendant.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，罷熙河蘭會路經制財用司。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the fiscal commissionerate for the Xihe Lankui circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Xihe Lankui fiscal commission was dissolved.

sentences.zh: 己卯，復廣濟河輦運。

translations.literal: Day jimao: transport on the Guangji Canal was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Guangji Canal grain transport resumed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔民間疾苦當議寬恤者，監司具聞。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: edict that where popular hardship warranted relief, circuit supervisors were to report in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, commissioners were to report any folk hardship needing easing.

sentences.zh: 以程頤爲崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: Cheng Yi was made lecturer at Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yi was appointed lecturer at Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，許職事官帶職。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: officeholders were permitted titular concurrent posts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, active officials were allowed to hold nominal concurrent titles.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳朔，以資政殿大學士韓維爲門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi, first of month: Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Han Wei was made Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingsi new moon: Han Wei became Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 罷諸路重祿，復熙寧前舊制。

translations.literal: Heavy salaries on all circuits were abolished and the pre-Xining system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit “heavy salary” posts were scrapped and pre-Xining pay rules restored.

sentences.zh: 庚申，夏人來賀即位。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Xia envoys came to congratulate the enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xia sent envoys to congratulate the new reign.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔侍從、台官、監司各舉縣令一人。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: attendants-in-waiting, censorial officials, and circuit commissioners were each to recommend one county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, each court attendant, censor, and circuit intendant was told to nominate one county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命程頤同修立國子監條制。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Cheng Yi was ordered to compile regulations for the Directorate of Education jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Cheng Yi was assigned to draft the Directorate of Education statutes.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸揚王、荊王第，官其子九人。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the emperor visited the mansions of the Princes of Yang and Jing; nine of their sons were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the court visited Princes Yang and Jing and commissioned nine of their sons.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復左、右天廄坊。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the left and right Imperial Stud Offices were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the left and right Imperial Studs were re-established.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔文彥博班宰相之上。

translations.literal: Day renwu, edict: Wen Yanbo was to rank above the prime ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Wen Yanbo was ordered to take precedence over the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，置《春秋》博士。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: a Lecturer on the Spring and Autumn was established.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen: a Spring and Autumn lecturer was added.

sentences.zh: 呂惠卿落職，分司南京、蘇州居住。

translations.literal: Lü Huiqing was demoted from office and assigned to reside at Nanjing and Suzhou with nominal posts.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Huiqing lost his post and was sent to nominal duty at Nanjing and Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以富弼配享神宗廟庭。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Fu Bi was granted shared sacrifice in Emperor Shenzong’s temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Fu Bi was enshrined beside Shenzong in the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔正風俗，修紀綱，勿理隱疵細故。

translations.literal: Day jiayin, edict: rectify customs and restore discipline; do not pursue hidden trivial faults.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the court called for moral order and told officials to stop hunting petty private offenses.

sentences.zh: 復置通利軍。

translations.literal: Tongli Army was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Tongli Army was restored.

sentences.zh: 程頤上疏論輔養君德。

translations.literal: Cheng Yi memorialized on cultivating the ruler’s virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yi submitted a memorial on nurturing the emperor’s moral conduct.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，置檢法官。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingsi: Investigating Officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingsi: investigating magistrates were created.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，設十科舉士法。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Ten-Category Examination for office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the ten-category civil service examination was instituted.

sentences.zh: 劉恕同修《資治通鑒》，未沾恩而卒，詔官其子。

translations.literal: Liu Shu had helped compile the Comprehensive Mirror to the Present but died before receiving favor; an edict gave his sons office.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shu, who helped edit the Comprehensive Mirror, died unrewarded; the court then posted his sons.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，夏國主秉常卒。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Xia ruler Bingchang died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Xia ruler Bingchang died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，夏國遣使賀坤成節。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Xia sent envoys to congratulate the Kuncheng festival.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Xia envoys came for the Grand Empress Dowager’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，詔常平依舊法，罷青苗錢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao, edict: Ever-Normal Granaries were to follow the old law; Green Sprouts loans were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinmao: Ever-Normal Granaries reverted to the old rules and Green Sprouts cash ended.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，封弟偲爲祁國公。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the younger brother Si was enfeoffed Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the emperor’s brother Si was made Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，占城國遣使入貢。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Champa sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Champa presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬子，日傍有五色雲。

translations.literal: Day renzi: five-colored clouds appeared beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, five-colored clouds were seen by the sun.

sentences.zh: 磁州穀異壟同穗。

translations.literal: In Cizhou, grain in different furrows bore identical ears.
translations.idiomatic: Cizhou reported grain in separate furrows with matching ears—an auspicious sign.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰朔，司馬光薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen, first of month: Sima Guang died.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingchen new moon: Sima Guang died.

sentences.zh: 己未，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: tribute was offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the court made offerings at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大享明堂，以神宗配，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Bright Hall was grandly sacrificed to, with Shenzong as associate; the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Bright Hall rites honored Shenzong as associate and brought a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，試中書舍人蘇軾爲翰林學士、知制誥。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: probationary drafting edict-writer Su Shi was made Hanlin Academician and drafter of proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Su Shi passed probation and became Hanlin academician and drafting edict-writer.

sentences.zh: 己卯，張璪罷。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Zhang Zao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Zhang Zao left office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，改衍聖公爲奉聖公。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingxu: the Duke Who Spread the Sage was renamed Duke Who Honors the Sage.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingxu: Confucius’s hereditary title was changed from “Spreading Sage” to “Honoring Sage.”

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Venus was visible by day again.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，夏人來告哀。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Xia envoys came to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xia sent envoys to report a death in mourning.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣使弔祭。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: envoys were sent to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Song sent envoys to mourn with Xia.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，以尚書左丞呂大防爲中書侍郎，御史中丞劉摯爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: Left Vice Director of the Ministries Lü Dafang was made Vice Director of Palace Affairs; Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhi was made Right Vice Director of the Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuwu: Lü Dafang became palace vice minister; Liu Zhi became right vice premier.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，于闐國遣使入貢。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Khotan sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Khotan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蠲鹽井官溪錢。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: official stream fees at salt wells were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, salt-well “official stream” levies were waived.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，詔將來服除，依元豐三年故事，群臣勿上尊號。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengyin, edict: when mourning ends in future, following the Yuanfeng 3 precedent, officials should not submit honorific titles.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengyin: after mourning, officials were barred from honorific title petitions, as in Yuanfeng 3.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，華州鄭縣小敷穀山崩。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Xiaofu Valley Mountain in Zheng County, Huazhou, collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Xiaofu Valley Mountain in Zheng, Huazhou, gave way.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔以冬溫無雪，決系囚。

translations.literal: Day wushen, edict: because the winter was warm and without snow, registered prisoners were released.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, a mild snowless winter prompted release of prisoners held for review.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河北、楚、海諸州水。

translations.literal: That year, Hebei and the Chu and Hai circuits suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods hit Hebei and the Chu and Hai regions.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙丑，封秉常子乾順爲夏國主。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day yichou: Bingchang’s son Qianshun was enfeoffed as Xia ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou 2, spring, yichou: Qianshun, son of Bingchang, was recognized as Xia ruler.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔舉人程試，主司毋得於《老》、《莊》、《列子》書命題。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: in metropolitan examinations, chief examiners must not set questions from the Laozi, Zhuangzi, or Liezi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, civil examiners were forbidden to test on Laozi, Zhuangzi, or Liezi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔蘇轍、劉分攵編次神宗御制。

translations.literal: Day xinsi, edict: Su Zhe and Liu Fen were to compile Shenzong’s imperial writings.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Su Zhe and Liu Fen were ordered to edit Shenzong’s collected writings.

sentences.zh: 白虹貫日。

translations.literal: A white rainbow crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A white rainbow spanned the sun.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，遣左司諫朱光庭使河北，振民被災者。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: Left Remonstrance Bureau remonstrator Zhu Guangting was sent to Hebei to relieve disaster victims.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai: Zhu Guangting was dispatched to Hebei to aid flood victims.

sentences.zh: 詔施、黔、戎、瀘等州保甲監司免歲閱。

translations.literal: Edict: circuit commissioners of Shi, Qian, Rong, Lu, and other prefectures were exempted from annual baojia review.
translations.idiomatic: Southwestern circuits were excused from yearly baojia inspections.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，加賜于闐國金帶、錦袍、器幣。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: additional gifts of a gold belt, brocade robe, and ritual goods were granted to Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Khotan received added gifts of belt, robe, and ritual vessels.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命吏部選人改官，歲以百人爲額。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Personnel Bureau candidates’ promotions were fixed at one hundred per year.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, civil-service promotions were capped at one hundred candidates a year.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔陝西、河東行策應牽制法。

translations.literal: Day xinchou, edict: the linked campaign supply law was implemented in Shaanxi and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Shaanxi and Hedong were ordered to use the mutual-support expedition supply rules.

sentences.zh: 是月，代州地震。

translations.literal: That month, Daizhou had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month an earthquake struck Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，太皇太后手詔，止就崇政殿受冊。

translations.literal: Third month, day renxu: the Grand Empress Dowager’s handwritten edict directed that investiture be received only at Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renxu: the Grand Empress Dowager’s own edict limited her investiture to Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔中外侍從歲舉郡守各一人。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: court and local attendants were each year to recommend one prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, every attendant at court and in the provinces was to nominate one prefect annually.

sentences.zh: 令御史台察民俗奢僭者。

translations.literal: The Censorate was ordered to investigate luxurious and excessive popular customs.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate was told to crack down on lavish and overreaching customs.

sentences.zh: 夏人遣使入謝。

translations.literal: Xia sent envoys to express thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Xia sent a thank-you mission.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，奉安神御于景靈宮宣光殿。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the imperial spirit tablet was installed at Xuanguang Hall in Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Shenzong’s spirit seat was placed in Xuanguang Hall at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔內侍省供奉官以下百人爲額。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, edict: Palace Domestic Service attendants below Palace Attendant were fixed at one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, inner-palace attendants were capped at one hundred below Palace Attendant rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，交阯入貢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingxu: Jiaozhi presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingxu: Jiaozhi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，鬼章子結齷齪寇洮東。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Gui Zhang’s son Jie’ezuo raided east of the Tao River.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Jie’ezuo, son of Gui Zhang, attacked east of Tao.

sentences.zh: 戊子，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔太師文彥博十日一議事都堂。

translations.literal: Day jichou, edict: Grand Mentor Wen Yanbo was to deliberate at the Joint Policy Hall every ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wen Yanbo was ordered to join cabinet sessions every ten days.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔：「冬夏旱暵，海內被災者廣，避殿減膳，責躬思過，以圖消復。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, edict: “Drought in winter and summer; disasters are widespread under Heaven. Avoid the hall, reduce meals, examine the self and reflect on faults, seeking restoration.”
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the emperor proclaimed drought austerity—leaving the hall, cutting meals, and repenting to win relief.

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，以四方牒訴上尚書者，或冤抑不得直，令御史分察之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: because petitions from all directions to the Ministry of Personnel sometimes met with unreceived injustice, censors were ordered to investigate them separately.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, censors were assigned to check provincial appeals that the Ministry of Personnel had failed to redress.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太皇太后以旱權罷受冊禮。

translations.literal: Day jihai: because of drought the Grand Empress Dowager temporarily suspended investiture ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, drought led the Grand Empress Dowager to postpone her investiture rites.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，雨。

translations.literal: Day guimao: rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, rain came.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以徐州布衣陳師道爲亳州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Xuzhou commoner Chen Shidao was made Revenue Clerk of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the scholar Chen Shidao of Xuzhou received a Bozhou revenue post.

sentences.zh: 丁未，復製科。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: special decree examinations were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the irregular “decree” examination track was revived.

sentences.zh: 戊申，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the emperor returned to the hall and restored meals.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the court ended austerity and resumed normal audiences and banquets.

sentences.zh: 李清臣罷。

translations.literal: Li Qingchen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qingchen left office.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，夏人圍南川砦。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guichou: Xia besieged Nanchuan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guichou: Xia laid siege to Nanchuan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以劉摯爲尚書左丞，兵部尚書王存爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Liu Zhi was made Left Vice Director of the Ministries; Minister of War Wang Cun was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Liu Zhi became left vice premier and Wang Cun right vice premier.

sentences.zh: 壬申，于闐入貢。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Khotan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Khotan sent tribute again.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔御史官闕，御史中丞、翰林學士、兩省諫議大夫以上雜舉。

translations.literal: Day dingchou, edict: when censor posts were vacant, the Censor-in-Chief, Hanlin Academicians, and remonstrators and drafting officials of both provinces might jointly recommend candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, vacant censor posts could be filled by joint nomination from top remonstrators and Hanlin scholars.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，以安燾知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinchou: An Tao was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinchou: An Tao took charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，有星如瓜出文昌。

translations.literal: Day renyin: a star like a melon appeared from the Wenchang constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, a melon-shaped star burst from Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，邈川首領結藥來降，授三班奉職。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Miaochuan chieftain Jieyao surrendered and was given a junior Palace Guard post.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Jieyao of Miaochuan submitted and received a third-rank palace guard commission.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，詔戶部修《會計錄》。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinhai, edict: the Revenue Ministry was to compile the Accounting Records.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinhai: the Revenue Ministry was ordered to revise the fiscal Accounting Records.

sentences.zh: 韓絳以司空致仕。

translations.literal: Han Jiang retired as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jiang retired with the honorary title Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏人寇鎮戎軍。

translations.literal: Xia raided Zhenrong Army.
translations.idiomatic: Xia attacked Zhenrong Army.

sentences.zh: 詔府界、三路教閱保甲。

translations.literal: Edict: the Capital District and the Three Circuits were to drill baojia militia.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region and Three Circuits were ordered to muster and train baojia.

sentences.zh: 復課利場務虧額科罰。

translations.literal: Penalties for revenue posts’ deficit quotas were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Fines for shortfalls at tax and monopoly stations were reinstated.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，罷諸州數外歲貢。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: extra annual tribute items from prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, surplus yearly local tribute lists were cut.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以遼蕭德崇等賀坤成節，曲宴垂拱殿，始用樂。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: for Liao envoys led by Xiao Dechong congratulating the Kuncheng festival, a banquet was held at Drooping Arch Hall; music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Liao’s Xiao Dechong was banqueted at Drooping Arch Hall for Kuncheng—the first such reception with music.

sentences.zh: 庚申，進封李乾德爲南平王。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Li Qiande was advanced to Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Li Qiande was promoted to Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，改誠州爲渠陽軍。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Chengzhou was changed to Quyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Chengzhou was redesignated Quyang Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，韓維罷。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Han Wei was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Han Wei left office.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，程頤罷經筵，權同管勾西京國子監。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinsi: Cheng Yi was dismissed from the Lectures Office and made acting overseer of the Western Capital Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinsi: Cheng Yi left the lectureship and was posted acting head of the Luoyang imperial college.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以西蕃寇洮、河，民被害者給錢粟，死者賜帛其家。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: because western Tibetans raided the Tao and He regions, victims were given money and grain; the dead were granted silk to their families.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Tao–He raid victims received cash and grain, and bereaved families received silk.

sentences.zh: 詔復進納人改官舊法。

translations.literal: Edict: the old law on promotion by tribute payment was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion through purchased grain tribute was put back on the old rules.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命呂大防爲西京安奉神宗御容禮儀使。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Lü Dafang was made Ritual Commissioner for Installing Shenzong’s Portrait at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Lü Dafang was charged with installing Shenzong’s portrait shrine at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，西南蕃遣人入貢。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: southwestern tribes sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, southwestern peoples presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以夏國政亂主幼，強臣乙逋等擅權逆命，詔諸路帥臣嚴兵備之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: because Xia was politically chaotic, the ruler young, and strongmen such as Yipo seized power in disobedience, an edict ordered circuit commanders to ready troops strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, with Xia torn by a child ruler and warlords like Yipo, frontier commanders were told to mobilize.

sentences.zh: 庚子，授西蕃首領心牟欽氈銀州團練使，溫溪心瓜州團練使。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: western Tibetan chieftains Xinmou Qinzhan and Wenxixin were made Tuanlian Commissioners of Yinzhou and Guazhou respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Xinmou Qinzhan and Wenxixin received regimental commissioner posts at Yinzhou and Guazhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，涇原言夏人寇三川諸砦，官軍敗之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Jingyuan reported that Xia raided stockades in the Sanchuan region and government troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Jingyuan reported a Xia strike on Sanchuan forts and a Song victory.

sentences.zh: 丁未，岷州行營將種誼復洮州，執蕃酋鬼章青宜結。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Minzhou campaign general Zhong Yi recovered Taozhou and captured the Tibetan chieftain Gui Zhang Qingyijie.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Zhong Yi retook Taozhou and seized Gui Zhang Qingyijie.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，發太皇太后冊寶于大慶殿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao: the Grand Empress Dowager’s investiture regalia were issued from Daqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yimao: the Grand Empress Dowager’s seals and register left Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，發皇太后、皇太妃冊寶於文德殿。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the Empress Dowager’s and Imperial Consort’s investiture regalia were issued from Wende Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Empress Dowager and Imperial Consort received their regalia from Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 己未，夏人寇鎮戎軍。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Xia raided Zhenrong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Xia struck Zhenrong Army again.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，禁私造金箔。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: private manufacture of gold foil was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, private manufacture of gold foil was banned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，奉安神宗御容于會聖宮及應天院。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renwu: Shenzong’s imperial portrait was installed at Huisheng Palace and Yingtian Cloister.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renwu: Shenzong’s portrait was installed at Huisheng Palace and Yingtian Cloister.

sentences.zh: 癸未，日有五色雲。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the sun showed five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, five-colored clouds appeared around the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊子，恭謝景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: thanksgiving was offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, thanksgiving rites were performed at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，減西京囚罪一等，杖已下釋之。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: western capital prisoners had sentences reduced one degree; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, western capital sentences dropped one grade and lesser offenders went free.

sentences.zh: 己亥，西南龍、張蕃遣人入貢。

translations.literal: Day jihai: southwestern Dragon and Zhang Fan tribes sent men to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, southwestern Dragon and Zhang Fan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，論復洮州功，種誼等遷秩、賜銀絹有差。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: merit in recovering Taozhou was discussed; Zhong Yi and others were promoted in rank and granted silver and silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhong Yi and others were rewarded in rank, silver, and silk for recovering Taozhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，復置漣水軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: Lianshui Army was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingchen: Lianshui Army was restored.

sentences.zh: 庚申，獻鬼章於崇政殿，以罪當死，聽招其子及部屬歸以自贖。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Gui Zhang was presented at Chongzheng Hall; though liable to death, he was allowed to summon his son and followers to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Gui Zhang was presented at Chongzheng Hall; though condemned to death, he could summon his son and followers to ransom himself.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，大雪甚，民凍多死，詔加振恤，死無親屬者官瘞之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: heavy snow killed many from cold; edict increased relief; where the dead had no kin, officials were to bury them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, severe snow and cold killed many; relief was increased and officials buried those without kin.

sentences.zh: 罷內殿承制試換文資格。

translations.literal: The exam for inner-hall commissioners to exchange into civil qualification was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-hall commissioners were no longer examined for transfer into the civil track.

sentences.zh: 丙子，決囚。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: prisoners were sentenced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, prisoners were sentenced.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，賜諸軍及貧民錢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: money was granted to the armies and the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yiyou: armies and the poor received cash grants.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，興龍節，初上壽於紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Xinglong Festival; for the first time longevity was celebrated at Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Xinglong Festival: the emperor’s birthday was first celebrated at Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大寒，罷集英殿宴。

translations.literal: Day jichou: severe cold; the Jiaying Hall banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, bitter cold canceled the Jiaying Hall banquet.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，兀征聲延部族老幼萬人渡河南，遣使廩食之，仍諭聲延勿失河北地。

translations.literal: Day renchen: ten thousand old and young of the Uzheng Shengyan tribe crossed south of the Yellow River; envoys were sent to provision them and they were told not to lose the lands north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, ten thousand Uzheng Shengyan tribespeople crossed the Yellow River; envoys fed them and warned them not to abandon the north bank.

sentences.zh: 乙未，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，頒《元祐敕令式》。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Yuan You Statutes, Edicts, and Forms were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Yuan You Statutes, Edicts, and Forms were issued.

sentences.zh: 是冬，始閉汴口。

translations.literal: That winter the Bian estuary was first closed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Bian estuary was closed for the first time.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己酉朔，不受朝。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day jiyou new moon: court audience was not held.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, first month, jiyou new moon: no court audience was held.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，復廣惠倉。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Guanghui Granary was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Guanghui Granary was reopened.

sentences.zh: 己未，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: offering was made at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the court worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，雪寒，發京西谷五十余萬石，損其直以紓民。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: snow and cold; more than five hundred thousand shi of western capital grain were released, with price reduced to ease the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, snow and cold spurred release of over five hundred thousand shi of western capital grain at reduced price.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔廣南西路朱崖軍開示恩信，許生黎悔過自新。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: Guangnan West circuit’s Zhuya commandery was to show grace and trust and allow raw Li who repented to renew themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhuya commandery was told to win raw Li back through grace and allow repentant tribesmen to reform.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，罷上元遊幸。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the Lantern Festival excursion was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Lantern Festival excursion was canceled.

sentences.zh: 壬申，阿里骨奉表詣闕謝罪，令邊將無出兵，仍罷招納。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Aligu submitted a memorial at court begging forgiveness; frontier generals were ordered not to send troops and recruitment of surrenders was still abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Aligu came to court to beg forgiveness; frontier generals were barred from campaigning and surrender recruitment stayed abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，決囚。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: prisoners were sentenced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, prisoners were sentenced.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，罷修金明池橋殿。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiashen: repair of Jinming Pool’s bridge halls was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiashen: work on Jinming Pool’s bridge halls was halted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，德音：減囚罪一等，徒以下釋之，工役權放一年，流民饑貧量與應副。

translations.literal: Day yiyou, benevolent edict: prisoners had sentences reduced one degree; those below penal servitude were released; corvée laborers were provisionally freed one year; destitute migrants and the hungry were given relief as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, a benevolent edict cut sentences one grade, freed lesser offenders, freed corvée laborers for a year, and aided destitute migrants.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔河東苦寒，量度存恤戍兵。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: because Hedong suffered bitter cold, measures were to be taken to sustain frontier garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Hedong’s bitter cold prompted orders to sustain frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罷春宴。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the spring banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the spring banquet was canceled.

sentences.zh: 乙未，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，廣東兵馬監童政坐擅殺無辜，伏誅。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Guangdong military supervisor Tong Zheng was executed for unauthorized killing of innocents.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Guangdong military supervisor Tong Zheng was executed for killing innocents on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，韓絳薨。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: Han Jiang died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingchen: Han Jiang died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，御集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: at Jiaying Hall the palace examination for civil graduates was held.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the palace civil examination was held at Jiaying Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊午，策武舉。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the military examination was held.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the military examination was held.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身一千一百二十二人。

translations.literal: Day jisi: one thousand one hundred twenty-two palace graduates of the Ministry of Rites list and other examination categories were granted jinshi and other degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, 1,122 Ministry of Rites graduates and examinees of other categories received degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，夏人寇德靜砦，將官張誠等敗之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Xia raided Dejing stockade; officer Zhang Cheng and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhang Cheng and others beat back a Xia raid on Dejing stockade.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，令諸路郡邑具役法利害以聞。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuyin, edict: each circuit’s prefectures and counties were to report the benefits and harms of the labor service law.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuyin: every prefecture and county was to report how the labor service law helped or harmed them.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以呂公著爲司空、同平章軍國事，呂大防爲尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎，范純仁爲尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Lü Gongzhu was made Minister of Works with joint management of state affairs; Lü Dafang was made left grand councilor and concurrently gate chief; Fan Chunren was made right grand councilor and concurrently palace chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Lü Gongzhu became Minister of Works with joint state management; Lü Dafang became left grand councilor; Fan Chunren became right grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以觀文殿學士孫固爲門下侍郎，劉摯爲中書侍郎，王存爲尚書左丞，御史中丞胡宗愈爲尚書右丞，戶部侍郎趙瞻簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Palace Library academician Sun Gu was made gate chief; Liu Zhi was made palace chief; Wang Cun was made left vice director; censor-in-chief Hu Zongyu was made right vice director; Ministry of Revenue vice minister Zhao Zhan countersigned Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Sun Gu, Liu Zhi, Wang Cun, Hu Zongyu, and Zhao Zhan took new council and Military Affairs posts.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔定職事官歲舉升陟人數。

translations.literal: Day guisi, edict: the annual quota for officeholders’ promotions was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, annual quotas for officeholders’ promotions were set.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，阿里骨來貢。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Aligu came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Aligu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔天下郡城以地裏置壯城兵額，禁勿他役。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: every prefectural city was to set a garrison militia quota by its territory; other corvée was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, each prefectural city was to raise a territorial garrison quota and forbid other levies on those men.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，漢東郡王宗瑗薨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai: Prince Zongyuan of Handong commandery died.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guihai: Prince Zongyuan of Handong died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，詔司諫、正言、殿中、監察御史，仿故事，以升朝官通判資序曆一年者爲之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao, edict: remonstrance officials, rectifiers, palace censors, and surveillance censors were, following precedent, to be drawn from metropolitan promotion circuit intendants with one year’s service.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guimao: remonstrance and censor posts were again to require a year as metropolitan promotion circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，夏人寇塞門砦。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Xia raided Saimen stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Xia raided Saimen stockade.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，五色雲見。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: five-colored clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, five-colored clouds appeared.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，荊王頵薨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: Prince Jing Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wushen: Prince Jing Ying died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰夜，東北方明如晝，俄成赤氣，中有白氣經天。

translations.literal: Night of day wuchen: the northeast was bright as day; soon it became red vapor, with white vapor crossing the sky within it.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuchen, the northeast blazed like day, then turned red with white streaks crossing the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，忠州言臨江塗井鎮雨黑黍。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Zhong prefecture reported black grain rained at Tujing town in Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Zhong prefecture reported black grain raining at Linjiang’s Tujing town.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，阿里骨入貢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuyin: Aligu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuyin: Aligu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 己卯，進封揚王顥爲徐王。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Yang Wang Ying was advanced to Xu Wang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Yang Wang Ying was made Prince Xu.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復置荊門軍。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Jingmen Army was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Jingmen Army was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，罷吏試斷刑法。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the officials’ examination in criminal law was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the officials’ criminal-law examination was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，渠陽蠻入寇。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Qiyang barbarians raided.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Qiyang tribes raided.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，降系囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: registered prisoners had sentences reduced one degree; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, registered prisoners dropped one grade and lesser offenders went free.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，禁宗室聯姻內臣家。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengshen: imperial clansmen were forbidden to marry inner-palace households.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengshen: imperial clansmen were barred from marrying inner-palace families.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，阿里骨復遷職，加封邑。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Aligu was again promoted in rank and enfeoffment was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Aligu was restored in rank and given a larger fief.

sentences.zh: 詔觀察使以上給永業田。

translations.literal: Edict: observation commissioners and above were granted perpetual estate fields.
translations.idiomatic: Observation commissioners and above received perpetual estate fields.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，御集英殿策賢良方正能直言極諫科。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: at Jiaying Hall the examination for Imperial Scholars Recommended for Eminence and Straightforwardness able to remonstrate extreme policy was held.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Jiaying Hall held the examination for eminent scholars able to remonstrate boldly.

sentences.zh: 十月丙戌，詔罷新創諸堡砦，廢渠陽軍。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingxu, edict: newly created stockades and forts were abolished and Qiyang army was disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingxu: new stockades were abolished and Qiyang army disbanded.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復南、北宣徽院。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the southern and northern Office of Palace Attendants was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the southern and northern Palace Attendant offices were restored.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，遣吏部侍郎范百祿等行河。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiachen: Ministry of Personnel vice minister Fan Bailu and others were sent to inspect the rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiachen: Fan Bailu and others were sent to inspect the rivers.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大食麻囉拔國入貢。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Dashi state of Maluoba sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Maluoba of the Dashi state sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔歲以十月給巡城兵衣裘。

translations.literal: Edict: each year in the tenth month patrol-city troops were issued fur coats.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol-city troops were to receive fur coats every tenth month.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，渝州獠人寇小溪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingyou: Liao tribesmen of Yu prefecture raided Xiaoxi.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingyou: Yu prefecture Liao tribesmen raided Xiaoxi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day renyin: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸卯朔，頒《元祐式》。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guimao new moon: the Yuan You Forms were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guimao new moon: the Yuan You Forms were issued.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，范鎮定鑄律、度量、鐘磬等以進，令禮部、太常參定。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Fan Zhen cast pitch pipes, measures, bells, and chimes and presented them; the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices were ordered to verify and fix them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Fan Zhen presented cast pitch pipes, measures, and bells; the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices were to verify them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，減宰執賜予。

translations.literal: Day wushen: grants to chief ministers were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, chief ministers’ stipends were cut.

sentences.zh: 庚申，置六曹尚書權官。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: acting posts for the six ministry directors were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, acting posts were set for the six ministry directors.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔吏部詳定六曹重復利害以聞。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, edict: the Ministry of Personnel was to detail the benefits and harms of overlap among the six ministries and report.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Ministry of Personnel was to report on overlap among the six ministries.

sentences.zh: 是歲，三佛齊、於闐、西南蕃入貢。

translations.literal: That year: Srivijaya, Khotan, and southwestern tribes sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Srivijaya, Khotan, and southwestern tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 天下上戶部：主戶二百一十三萬四千七百三十三，丁二千八百五十三萬三千九百三十四。

translations.literal: Empire-wide registered households: principal households 2,134,733 with 28,533,934 adult males.
translations.idiomatic: Empire-wide principal households numbered 2,134,733 with 28,533,934 adult males.

sentences.zh: 客戶六百一十五萬四千六百五十二，丁三百六十二萬九千八十三。

translations.literal: Client households 6,154,652 with 3,629,083 adult males.
translations.idiomatic: Client households numbered 6,154,652 with 3,629,083 adult males.

sentences.zh: 斷大辟二千九百一十五人。

translations.literal: Capital-grade death sentences: 2,915.
translations.idiomatic: Capital death sentences: 2,915.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬申朔，不受朝，群臣及遼使詣東上閣門、內東門拜表賀。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day renshen new moon: court audience was not held; ministers and Liao envoys paid respects with memorials of congratulation at the eastern upper gate and inner eastern gate.
translations.idiomatic: Year four, first month, renshen new moon: no audience; ministers and Liao envoys offered New Year felicitations at the gates.

sentences.zh: 丙子，宴遼使於紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Liao envoys were banqueted at Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Liao envoys were feasted at Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以夏人通好，詔邊將毋生事。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: because Xia had made peace, frontier generals were ordered not to provoke incidents.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Xia’s peace pact barred frontier generals from provocation.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，呂公著薨。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: Lü Gongzhu died.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiachen: Lü Gongzhu died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，夏人來謝封冊。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Xia came to thank for the investiture patent.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Xia came to thank for the investiture.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，作渾天儀。

translations.literal: Third month, day jimao: an armillary sphere was made.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jimao: an armillary sphere was constructed.

sentences.zh: 胡宗愈罷。

translations.literal: Hu Zongyu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zongyu left office.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以不雨，罷春宴。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because of drought, the spring banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, drought canceled the spring banquet.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔自今大禮毋上尊號。

translations.literal: Day jichou, edict: from now on no honorific title was to be offered at great rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, great rites were barred from adding honorific titles.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，晝有流星出東方。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: by day a meteor appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, a daytime meteor appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，錄囚。

translations.literal: Day guisi: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，罷幸瓊林苑、金明池。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: excursions to Qionlin Garden and Jinming Pool were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, outings to Qionlin Garden and Jinming Pool were canceled.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，詔自今侍讀以三人爲額。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiyou, edict: from now the lecturing readerate was fixed at three posts.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guiyou: the lecturing readerate was capped at three posts.

sentences.zh: 中丞李常、侍御史盛陶坐不論蔡確，改官。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Li Chang and attendant censor Sheng Tao were demoted for not impeaching Cai Que.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Li Chang and attendant censor Sheng Tao were demoted for failing to impeach Cai Que.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，貶觀文殿學士蔡確爲光祿卿。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: demoted Palace Library academician Cai Que was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, demoted academician Cai Que was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復貶確爲英州別駕、安置新州。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Cai Que was again demoted to Yingzhou registrar and was settled at Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Cai Que was again demoted to Yingzhou registrar and exiled to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，于闐國來貢。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Khotan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Khotan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，範純仁、王存罷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: Fan Chunren and Wang Cun were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen: Fan Chunren and Wang Cun left office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以趙瞻同知樞密院事，戶部尚書韓忠彥爲尚書左丞，翰林學士許將爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Zhao Zhan was made associate Military Affairs commissioner; Ministry of Revenue director Han Zhongyan was made left vice director; Hanlin academician Xu Jiang was made right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhao Zhan joined Military Affairs; Han Zhongyan and Xu Jiang became left and right vice directors.

sentences.zh: 丁未，夏國來貢。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Xia sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，邈黎國般次泠移、四林栗迷等齎于闐國黑汗王及其國蕃王表章來貢。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Banci Lengyi, Silin Limi, and others of Miaoli brought memorials from the Black Khan of Khotan and his realm’s tribal kings as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Miaoli’s Banci Lengyi and Silin Limi presented tribute memorials from Khotan’s Black Khan and his kings.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，詔復外都水使者。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingzi, edict: the outer metropolitan water commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingzi: the outer waterworks directorate was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遼國使蕭寅等來賀坤成節，曲宴垂拱殿。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Liao envoys led by Xiao Yin came to congratulate the Kuncheng festival; a private banquet was held at Drooping Arch Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Xiao Yin of Liao came for Kuncheng and was banqueted at Drooping Arch Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，安燾以母憂去位。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: An Yan left office on account of his mother’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, An Yan quit for filial mourning.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，敕郡守貳以「四善三最」課縣令，吏部歲上監司考察知州狀。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin, edict: prefectural deputies were to evaluate county magistrates by the “Four Excellences and Three Bests”; each year the Ministry of Personnel was to submit surveillance commissioners’ assessment reports on prefects.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renyin: deputies were to grade magistrates on the Four Excellences and Three Bests, and Personnel yearly forwarded supervisors’ prefect reports.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太皇太后詔：今後明堂大禮，毋令百官拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Grand Empress Dowager decreed that hereafter at Bright Hall grand rites officials were not to submit congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the grand empress dowager barred congratulatory memorials at future Bright Hall rites.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，致齋垂拱殿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuyin: ritual abstention at Drooping Arch Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuyin: ritual abstention at Drooping Arch Hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，朝獻景靈宮，辛巳，大饗明堂，赦天下，百官加恩，賜齎士庶高年九十以上者。

translations.literal: Day jimao: audience offering at Jingling Palace; day xinsi: great feast at the Bright Hall; amnesty for all under Heaven; officials received added grace; gifts were bestowed on commoners aged ninety and above.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao they offered at Jingling; on xinsi they feasted at the Bright Hall, pardoned the realm, ennobled officials, and gave gifts to commoners over ninety.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，加賜韓縝、範純仁器幣有差。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Han Zhen and Fan Chunren were given additional gifts of vessels and silks in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Han Zhen and Fan Chunren received extra vessels and silks in differing amounts.

sentences.zh: 乙未，檢舉先朝文武七條，戒諭百官遵守。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the seven articles for civil and military officials of the prior reign were compiled and officials admonished to observe them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, seven rules for Shenzong’s civil and military service were promulgated and officials warned to obey.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，西南程蕃入貢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinchou: southwestern Cheng Fan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinchou: southwestern Cheng tribes brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，龍蕃入貢。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Long Fan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Long Fan brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊申，翰林學士蘇轍上《神宗御集》，藏寶文閣。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Hanlin academician Su Zhe presented the Collected Writings of Shenzong; they were stored in Baowen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Su Zhe presented Shenzong’s collected writings to Baowen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，御邇英殿，講官進講《三朝寶訓》。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the emperor attended Yingying Hall; lecturers advanced and lectured on the Precious Instructions of Three Reigns.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, at Yingying Hall lecturers expounded the Precious Instructions of Three Reigns.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，敕朝請大夫以下進士爲左，餘爲右。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengwu, edict: for Court Gentlemen for Imperial Audience and below, jinshi degree holders were placed on the left and the rest on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengwu: below Court Gentleman rank, jinshi stood left and others right.

sentences.zh: 溪洞彭儒武等進溪洞布。

translations.literal: Peng Ruwu and others of the Xidong grottoes presented xidong cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Ruwu of the xidong grottoes presented native cloth.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以孫固知樞密院事，劉摯爲門下待郎，吏部尚書傅堯俞爲中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Sun Gu was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Liu Zhi was made Vice Minister of the Gate; Fu Yaoyu, Minister of Personnel, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Sun Gu took the Military Commission, Liu Zhi the gate vice ministership, and Fu Yaoyu the Secretariat vice ministership.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，有星色赤黃，尾跡燭地。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: a star of red-yellow color appeared; its tail’s track lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, a red-yellow star blazed to earth with a fiery tail.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太皇太后卻元日賀禮，令百官拜表。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Grand Empress Dowager declined New Year’s congratulations and ordered officials to submit memorials instead.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the grand empress dowager refused New Year audiences and took congratulatory memorials instead.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，章惇買田不法，降官。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Zhang Dun bought land unlawfully and was demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Zhang Dun was demoted for illegal land purchases.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改發運、轉運、提刑預妓樂宴會徒二年法。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the law punishing transport, circuit transport, and judicial intendant officials who preside over prostitute-music feasts with two years’ penal servitude was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the two-year sentence for transport and intendant officials who host brothel banquets was revised.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，遼使耶律常等賀興龍節，曲宴垂拱殿。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengzi: Liao envoys led by Yelü Chang came to congratulate the Xinglong festival; a private banquet was held at Drooping Arch Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengzi: Yelü Chang of Liao came for Xinglong and was banqueted at Drooping Arch Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，更定朝儀二舞曰《威加四海》、《化成天下》。

translations.literal: Day guichou: court ritual’s two dances were redesignated “Awesomeness Fills the Four Seas” and “Transforming and Completing the World.”
