translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the court dances were renamed Awesomeness Fills the Four Seas and Transforming and Completing the World.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，減鄜延等路戍兵歸營。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: garrison troops on the Fuyan and other circuits were reduced and returned to camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Fuyan and other frontier garrisons were thinned and sent back to camp.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以御史闕，令中丞、兩省各舉二人。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: because censor posts were vacant, the censor-in-chief and the Two Departments were each to recommend two men.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, with censor posts empty, the censor-in-chief and Two Departments each nominated two men.

sentences.zh: 是歲，夏國、邈黎、大食、麻囉拔國入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Xia, Miaoli, Dashi, and Malab presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xia, Miaoli, Arabia, and Malab sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁卯朔，御大慶殿視朝。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, day dingmao new moon: the emperor held audience at Daqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Year five, spring, dingmao new moon: he held court at Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: audience offering at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, offerings were made at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，罷諸州、軍通判奏舉改官。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou: the practice of vice-prefects in all prefectures and armies memorializing candidates for appointment changes was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingyou: vice-prefects’ memorial routes for promotion were abolished.

sentences.zh: 己亥，夏人歸永樂所掠吏士百四十九人。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Xia returned one hundred forty-nine officials and soldiers captured at Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Xia returned 149 officials and soldiers taken at Yongle.

sentences.zh: 庚子，加溪洞人田忠進等九十二人檢校官有差。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: ninety-two xidong men including Tian Zhongjin were given provisional offices in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, ninety-two xidong leaders including Tian Zhongjin received provisional ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以旱罷，修黃河。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: because of drought, Yellow River works were halted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, drought halted Yellow River repairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，禱雨嶽瀆，罷浚京城壕。

translations.literal: Day guimao: rain was prayed for at the sacred mountains and rivers; dredging the capital moat was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, prayers rose at the sacred peaks and rivers and capital moat work stopped.

sentences.zh: 丁未，減天下囚罪，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: crimes of prisoners throughout the empire were reduced; those below the beating grade were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, sentences empire-wide were lightened and beating-grade prisoners freed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，文彥博乙太師充護國軍、山南西道節度等使致仕，令所司備禮冊命。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Wen Yanbo was made Grand Preceptor with concurrent commands as military commissioner of Huguo Army and Shannan West circuit and retired; the relevant offices were ordered to prepare ritual patent documents.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Wen Yanbo became grand preceptor, took Huguo and Shannan West commands, retired, and was promised full patent rites.

sentences.zh: 壬子，彥博乞免冊禮，從之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Yanbo asked to be excused from the patent ceremony; assent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Yanbo declined the patent ceremony and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，宴餞文彥博於玉津園。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: a farewell banquet for Wen Yanbo was held at Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wen Yanbo was banqueted farewell at Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅朔，趙瞻薨。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingyin new moon: Zhao Zhan died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingyin new moon: Zhao Zhan died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔賜故孫覺家緡錢，令給喪事。

translations.literal: Day dingmao, edict: cash was granted to the family of the late Sun Jue to cover funeral expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Sun Jue’s family received cash for his funeral.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以韓忠彥同知樞密院事，翰林學士承旨蘇頌爲尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Han Zhongyan was made co-director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Hanlin academician-in-chief Su Song was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Han Zhongyan joined the Military Commission and Su Song became left vice director.

sentences.zh: 癸未，罷春宴。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the spring banquet was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the spring banquet was cancelled.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷幸金明池、瓊林苑。

translations.literal: Day renchen: visits to Jinming Pool and Qionlin Garden were cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, outings to Jinming Pool and Qionlin Garden were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，詔鄭穆、王岩叟等同舉監察御史二員。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao, edict: Zheng Mu, Wang Yansou, and others were jointly to recommend two investigating censors.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guimao: Zheng Mu, Wang Yansou, and others were to nominate two investigating censors.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，呂大防等以旱求退，不允。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Lü Dafang and others asked to retire because of drought; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Lü Dafang and others sought to quit over the drought and were refused.

sentences.zh: 丙午，孫固薨。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Sun Gu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Sun Gu died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔講讀官御經筵退，留二員奏對邇英閣。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: after lecturers at the classics mat retired, two were to remain and present memorials at Yingying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, two lecturers were to stay after the classics mat and answer at Yingying Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔以旱、避殿減膳，罷五月朔日文德殿視朝。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: because of drought, the hall was avoided and meals reduced; the fifth-month new-moon audience at Wende Hall was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, drought brought hall avoidance, reduced meals, and no fifth-month new-moon audience at Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以保甯軍節度使馮京爲檢校司空。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Baoning Army military commissioner Feng Jing was made honorary Sikong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Feng Jing of Baoning Army became honorary Sikong.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，詔差役法有未備者，令王岩叟等具利害以聞。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renshen, edict: where the labor-service law remained incomplete, Wang Yansou and others were to set out advantages and disadvantages for report.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renshen: Wang Yansou and others were to report gaps in the labor-service law.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雨。

translations.literal: Day yihai: it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 己卯，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day jimao: meals at court in the hall were resumed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, normal court meals resumed.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，錄囚。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinchou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinchou: the prisons were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，晝有五色雲。

translations.literal: Day guihai: five-colored clouds appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, five-colored clouds showed by day.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，涇原路經略司言：諸人違制典買蕃部田土，許以免罪，自二頃五十畝以下，責其出刺弓箭手及買馬備邊用各有差。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renshen: the Jingyuan circuit pacification office reported: persons who in violation of regulations mortgaged or bought Fan tribal lands might be exempted from punishment; from two qing fifty mu downward, they were charged to furnish crossbowmen and purchase horses for frontier use in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen: Jingyuan allowed illegal Fan land buyers to escape punishment by supplying archers and horses scaled to holdings under 2.5 qing.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，夏人來議分畫疆界。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Xia came to negotiate demarcation of the border.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xia came to negotiate the border.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，詔復置集賢院學士。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou, edict: Jixian Academy academician posts were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingchou: Jixian Academy academician posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，罷提舉修河司。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guisi: the office for directing Yellow River repairs was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guisi: the Yellow River repair commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔定州韓琦祠載祀典。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: the shrine to Han Qi at Ding Prefecture was entered in the register of state sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Han Qi’s Dingzhou shrine was entered in the state sacrifice register.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛酉朔，不受朝，群臣及遼使詣東上閣門、內東門拜表賀。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month, day xinyou new moon: court audience was not held; ministers and Liao envoys went to the Eastern Upper Gate and Inner Eastern Gate to submit congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Year six, spring, xinyou new moon: there was no audience; officials and Liao envoys congratulated by memorial at the gates.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔祠祭、游幸毋用羔。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: in sacrifices and tours lambs were not to be used.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, sacrifices and tours were forbidden to use lambs.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，以劉摯爲尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎，龍圖閣待制王岩叟簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinmao: Liu Zhi was made Right Grand Councilor and concurrent Vice Director of the Secretariat; Wang Yansou, awaiting appointment at Dragon Diagram Hall, signed the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinmao: Liu Zhi became right grand councilor and Secretariat vice director; Wang Yansou signed the Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以蘇轍爲尚書右丞，宗室士伣追封魏國公。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Su Zhe was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; clansman Shixian was posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Su Zhe became right vice director and clansman Shixian was posthumously made Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 庚子，拂箖國來貢。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the state of Folin presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Folin sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，授阿里骨男溪邦彪篯爲化外庭州團練使。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Aligu’s son Xibang Biaojian was appointed regiment commander of Tingzhou beyond the registers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Aligu’s son Xibang Biaojian became Tingzhou regiment commander outside the registers.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，呂大防上《神宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Third month, day guihai: Lü Dafang presented the Veritable Records of Shenzong.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guihai: Lü Dafang submitted Shenzong’s Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 己巳，御集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day jisi: at Jiying Hall the jinshi examination was conducted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the jinshi examination was held at Jiying Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚午，策武舉。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the military examination was conducted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the military examination was held.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔御史中丞舉殿中侍御史二人，翰林學士至諫議大夫同舉監察御史二人。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: the censor-in-chief was to recommend two palace censors; from Hanlin academician through remonstrance and policy officials jointly to recommend two investigating censors.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the censor-in-chief nominated two palace censors and Hanlin-through-remonstrance officials two investigating censors.

sentences.zh: 丙子，呂大防特授右正議大夫。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Lü Dafang was specially granted Right Rectifier Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Lü Dafang received the special title Right Rectifier Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身九百五十七人。

translations.literal: Day renwu: nine hundred fifty-seven men who passed the Ministry of Rites jinshi and various-subject examinations were granted degrees and origins.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, 957 jinshi and specialist examinees received degrees.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，罷幸金明池、瓊林苑。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: visits to Jinming Pool and Qionlin Garden were cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, outings to Jinming Pool and Qionlin Garden were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，復置通禮科。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiwei: the Comprehensive Rites subject was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yiwei: the Comprehensive Rites examination subject was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔恤刑。

translations.literal: Day bingshen, edict: compassionate review of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, punishments were reviewed with leniency.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔大臣堂除差遣，非行能卓異者不可輕授。

translations.literal: Day xinchou, edict: grand-council appointments from the chief ministers’ hall must not be lightly given except to those of outstanding ability and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, hall appointments were barred unless merit was truly outstanding.

sentences.zh: 仍搜訪遺材，以備擢任。

translations.literal: Hidden talent was still to be sought for promotion and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The court still sought overlooked talent for promotion.

sentences.zh: 夏人寇熙河蘭岷、鄜延路。

translations.literal: Xia raided the Xihe Lan-Min and Fuyan circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Xia raided Xihe Lan-Min and Fuyan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜南平王李乾德袍帶、金帛、鞍馬。

translations.literal: Day renzi: robes, belts, gold, silks, and saddle horses were bestowed on Prince of Nanping Li Qiande.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Li Qiande of Nanping received robes, gold, silks, and horses.

sentences.zh: 五月己未朔，日有食之，罷文德殿視朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiwei new moon: there was a solar eclipse; the audience at Wende Hall was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiwei new moon: an eclipse cancelled the Wende Hall audience.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔娶宗室女得官者，毋過朝請大夫、皇城使。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, edict: those who gained office by marrying imperial clanswomen might not rise above Court Gentleman for Imperial Audience or Imperial City commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, men who married clanswomen were capped at Court Gentleman and Imperial City commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，後省上《元祐敕令格》。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Rear Secretariat submitted the Yuanyou Statutes and Regulations collection.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Rear Secretariat submitted the Yuanyou statutes and regulations.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，錄囚。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renchen: the prisons were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，置國史院修撰官。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: compiler posts at the National History Academy were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, National History Academy compiler posts were created.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔以田思利爲銀青光祿大夫，充溪洞都巡檢。

translations.literal: Day yimao, edict: Tian Sili was made Silver-Bright Grand Master of Glory and made chief inspector of the xidong grottoes.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Tian Sili became Silver-Bright Grand Master and xidong chief inspector.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，復張方平宣徽南院使致仕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guihai: Zhang Fangping, retired, was restored as commissioner of the Southern Court of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guihai: retired Zhang Fangping was restored as southern military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復製置解鹽使。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the monopoly commissioner for regulated salt was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the regulated-salt monopoly commissioner was restored.

sentences.zh: 己卯，振兩浙水災。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the two Zhe circuits were relieved for flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the two Zhe circuits received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，三省進納後六禮儀制。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: the Three Departments submitted protocols for the latter six rites.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jichou: the Three Departments submitted the latter six rites protocols.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔御史台：臣僚親亡十年不葬，許依條彈奏及令吏部檢察。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, edict to the Censorate: where officials’ parents had lain unburied ten years, impeachment under the statutes was permitted and the Ministry of Personnel was to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, officials who left parents unburied ten years could be impeached and Personnel told to inspect.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改宗正屬籍曰《宗藩慶系錄》。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Genealogy Office’s register of dependent kin was renamed Record of Imperial Clans and Celebrated Lines.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the clansmen register was retitled Record of Imperial Clans and Celebrated Lines.

sentences.zh: 令文武臣出入京城門書職位、差遣、姓名及所往。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials entering and leaving the capital gates were ordered to write their posts, assignments, names, and destinations.
translations.idiomatic: Officials passing the capital gates had to record post, assignment, name, and destination.

sentences.zh: 己酉，修《神宗寶訓》。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Precious Instructions of Shenzong were compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Shenzong’s Precious Instructions were compiled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔鄜延路都監李儀等以違旨夜出兵入界，與夏人戰死，不贈官，餘官降等。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: Fuyan circuit supervisors Li Yi and others, for deploying troops by night against orders and crossing the border to fight Xia, died in battle without posthumous rank; the rest were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Li Yi and other Fuyan supervisors who died raiding Xia at night received no posthumous rank; survivors were demoted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，夏人寇懷遠砦。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Xia raided Huaiyuan stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Xia hit Huaiyuan stockade.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬戌，嚴飭陝西、河東諸路邊備。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renxu: frontier preparations on the Shaanxi and Hedong circuits were tightened.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, renxu: Shaanxi and Hedong frontiers were put on strict alert.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Venus shone at noon again.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔御史中丞舉殿中侍御史二人，翰林學士、中書舍人、給事中舉監察御史四人。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: the censor-in-chief was to recommend two palace censors; Hanlin academician, Secretariat drafter, and Secretariat receptionist jointly to recommend four investigating censors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the censor-in-chief nominated two palace censors and Hanlin, drafting, and reception officials four investigating censors.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太子太保致事張方平辭免宣徽使，不允。

translations.literal: Day renshen: retired Grand Mentor Zhang Fangping declined the military affairs post; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, retired Zhang Fangping tried to refuse the military affairs post and was overruled.

sentences.zh: 甲申，刑部侍郎彭汝礪與執政爭獄事，自乞貶逐，詔改禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Vice Minister of Punishments Peng Rulin quarreled with the chief ministers over a legal case, asked to be banished, and was made Vice Minister of Rites by edict.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Peng Rulin clashed with the cabinet over a case, sought banishment, and was moved to Rituals.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，夏人寇麟、府二州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dinghai: Xia raided Lin and Fu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dinghai: Xia raided Lin and Fu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔州民爲寇所掠，廬舍焚蕩者給錢帛，踐稼者振之，失牛者官貸市之。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: where prefectural people had been plundered by bandits and dwellings burned, money and silk were granted; where crops had been trampled, relief was given; where cattle had been lost, the government lent funds to buy replacements.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, raid victims got cash and cloth for burned homes, relief for trampled fields, and official loans to replace lost cattle.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，御集英殿策賢良方正能直言極諫科。

translations.literal: Day guisi: at Jiaying Hall he examined candidates in the Worthies and Straightforward, Able to Speak Bluntly and Remonstrate Extremely category.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Jiaying Hall held the Worthies and Straightforward blunt-remonstrance examination.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，御試方正王普等，遷官有差。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: in the palace examination Wang Pu and other Worthies and Straightforward candidates received graded promotions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Wang Pu and fellow examinees were promoted by rank.

sentences.zh: 歲出內庫緡錢五十萬以備邊費。

translations.literal: Fifty thousand strings of cash from the inner treasury were issued yearly for border expenses.
translations.idiomatic: The inner treasury sent fifty thousand strings a year for the frontier.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸上清儲祥宮。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: he visited the Shangqing Palace of Stored Auspice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, he visited Shangqing Palace of Stored Auspice.

sentences.zh: 壬子，宮成，減天下囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: when the palace was completed, crimes of prisoners throughout the realm were reduced one degree; those below beating were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the new palace brought a one-degree commutation empire-wide and release of lesser offenders.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以執政官行謁禁法非便，詔有利害陳述勿禁。

translations.literal: Day guichou: because executive officials’ taboo rules on audiences were inconvenient, an edict said statements of benefit and harm were not to be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, taboo rules on ministerial audiences were eased so frank statements of benefit and harm were allowed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，有流星晝出東北。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingmao: a meteor appeared by day in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingmao: a daytime meteor appeared in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 庚午，朝獻景靈宮，還，幸國子監，賜祭酒豐稷三品服，監學官賜帛有差。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: he offered at Jingling Palace; on returning he visited the Directorate of Education, bestowing third-rank robes on vice chancellor Feng Ji and granting silk to the school officials in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, after Jingling he visited the Directorate of Education, gave Feng Ji third-rank robes, and granted silk to the school staff.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，令諸宮院建小學。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: he ordered every palace compound to establish an elementary school.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, every palace compound was told to open an elementary school.

sentences.zh: 貴妃苗氏薨。

translations.literal: Noble Consort Miao died.
translations.idiomatic: Noble Consort Miao died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，編修神宗御制官轉秩加賞。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: compilers of Shenzong’s imperial compositions received promotions in rank with rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, compilers of Shenzong’s imperial writings were promoted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 詔京西提刑司歲給錢物二十萬緡，以奉陵寢。

translations.literal: Edict: the Jingxi surveillance commission was to grant two hundred thousand strings of cash and goods yearly to maintain the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxi surveillance was to send two hundred thousand strings yearly for tomb upkeep.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲辰，以遼使耶律迪卒，輟朝一日。

translations.literal: Year seven, spring, first month, day jiachen: because the Liao envoy Yelü Di had died, court was suspended one day.
translations.idiomatic: Year seven, first month, jiachen: court paused one day for the death of Yelü Di of Liao.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，張誠一以穿父墓取犀帶，責授左武衛將軍，提舉亳州明道宮。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Zhang Chengyi, for digging open his father’s tomb to take a rhinoceros-horn belt, was demoted to Left Martial Guard general and assigned to Bozhou Mingdao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhang Chengyi was demoted to Left Martial Guard general and sent to Mingdao Palace at Bozhou for robbing his father’s grave for a rhinoceros belt.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，詔陝西、河東邊要進築守禦城砦。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingmao, edict: on the Shaanxi and Hedong frontiers, key points were to advance-build defensive stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingmao: Shaanxi and Hedong were told to build frontier stockades.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，錄囚。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jihai: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，立皇后孟氏。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiwei: Empress Meng was installed.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiwei: Empress Meng was installed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命呂大防爲皇后六禮使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Lü Dafang was appointed commissioner for the empress’s six rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lü Dafang was named commissioner for the empress’s six rites.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，立考察縣令課績法。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: a law for evaluating county magistrates’ performance was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, county magistrates were put under a performance-review law.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，御文德殿冊皇后。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: the empress was enthroned at Wende Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuxu: the empress was enthroned at Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷侍從官轉對。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: attendance remonstrance by attendant officials was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, attendant remonstrance at court was ended.

sentences.zh: 丙午，王岩叟罷知鄭州。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wang Yansou left office as prefect of Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wang Yansou left Zhengzhou prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大食進火浣布。

translations.literal: Dashi presented fire-wash cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Dashi sent fire-wash cloth.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，以呂大防爲右光祿大夫，蘇頌爲尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎，韓忠彥知樞密院事，蘇轍爲門下侍郎，翰林學士范百祿爲中書侍郎，翰林學士梁燾爲尚書左丞，御史中丞鄭雍爲尚書右丞，戶部尚書劉奉世簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou: Lü Dafang was made Right Glory Grandee; Su Song Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Central Secretariat Vice Director; Han Zhongyan Military Affairs Commissioner; Su Zhe Left Secretariat Vice Director; Hanlin academician Fan Bailu Central Secretariat Vice Director; Hanlin academician Liang Tao Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works; censor-in-chief Zheng Yong Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works; Minister of Revenue Liu Fengshi signing Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinyou: Lü Dafang became Right Glory Grandee; Su Song joined the council; Han Zhongyan took Military Affairs; Su Zhe and Fan Bailu became vice directors; Liang Tao and Zheng Yong were vice ministers; Liu Fengshi signed at Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲子，置廣文館解額。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: a Guangwen Hall examination quota was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, a Guangwen Hall examination quota was set.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，渾天儀像成。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the armillary sphere and celestial globe were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the armillary sphere and celestial globe were finished.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，日旁五色雲見。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: five-colored clouds appeared beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, five-colored clouds appeared beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 七月癸巳，詔修《神宗史》。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guisi, edict: compile the Shenzong Annals.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guisi: compilation of the Shenzong Annals was ordered.

sentences.zh: 復翰林侍講學士。

translations.literal: The Hanlin attending exposition academician was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanlin attending exposition post was restored.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔諸路安撫鈐轄司及西京、南京各賜《資治通鑒》一部。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, edict: every circuit pacification and military commission, and Western and Southern Capital, each received one copy of the Comprehensive Mirror to Aid in Government.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, each frontier commission and the two capitals received a copy of the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宗室緦麻以上者禁析居。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: imperial clansmen of trim mourning and above were forbidden to split households.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, close imperial clansmen were barred from splitting households.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，罷監酒稅務增剩給賞法。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingchen: the law granting rewards for surplus wine-tax collections was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingchen: rewards for wine-tax surpluses ended.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔西邊諸將嚴備，毋輕出兵。

translations.literal: Day jiwei, edict: western border generals were to keep strict readiness and not send troops lightly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, western generals were warned to stay ready and not strike rashly.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，戒邊將毋掊克軍士。

translations.literal: Day yihai: border generals were warned not to squeeze their soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, border generals were forbidden to cheat their troops.

sentences.zh: 前陷交阯將吏蘇佐等十七人自拔來歸。

translations.literal: Seventeen former Jiaozhi officers including Su Zuo, who had been trapped there, escaped and came back of their own accord.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen trapped Jiaozhi officers including Su Zuo broke free and returned voluntarily.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，詔：「冬至日南郊，宜依故事設皇地祇位。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuxu, edict: “At the winter solstice southern suburb, the Earth Sovereign’s place should be set according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuxu: “At the winter-solstice southern suburb, the Earth Sovereign’s seat should follow precedent,” the edict said.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，別議方澤之儀以聞。

translations.literal: When the rites were finished, the Square Mound ritual was to be discussed separately and reported.”
translations.idiomatic: “After the rite, report separately on the Square Mound ceremony.”

sentences.zh: 」己酉，永興軍、蘭州、鎮戎軍地震。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Yongxing army, Lanzhou, and Zhenrong army were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Yongxing, Lanzhou, and Zhenrong were hit by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌朔，環州地震。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengxu, new moon: Huanzhou was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengxu new moon: Huanzhou quaked.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，陝西有前代帝王陵廟處，給民五家充守陵戶。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: wherever in Shaanxi there were tombs of former dynasties’ emperors, five households each were granted as tomb-guard families.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, five households each were assigned to guard former imperial tombs in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，夏人寇環州。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Xia raided Huanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Xia raided Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinsi: Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔太中大夫以上許占永業田。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, edict: grand masters and above were permitted to occupy perpetual-estate fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, grand masters and above could hold perpetual-estate fields.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，于闐入貢。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Khotan came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Khotan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，帝齋大慶殿。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the emperor fasted at Daqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, he fasted at Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: he offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, he worshipped at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day renchen: he feasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he feasted at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，祀天地於圜丘，赦天下，群臣中外加恩。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Round Mound; all under Heaven was pardoned; court and abroad received graded favors.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, he sacrificed at the Round Mound, pardoned the realm, and granted favors at court and abroad.

sentences.zh: 罷南京榷酒。

translations.literal: The Nanjing wine monopoly was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing’s wine monopoly ended.

sentences.zh: 民罹親喪者，戶以差等與免徭。

translations.literal: Those suffering parental mourning had corvée remitted by household according to graded tiers.
translations.idiomatic: Bereaved households had corvée remitted by graded tiers.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賜徐王劍履上殿。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Prince Xu was granted sword and shoes to ascend the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Prince Xu received sword-and-shoes hall access.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，阿里骨、李乾德加食邑實封。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: Aligu and Li Qiande received increased fief and actual enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinhai: Aligu and Li Qiande gained fief and actual enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 甲子，罷飲福宴。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the drinking-blessing feast was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the drinking-blessing feast was ended.

sentences.zh: 庚午，祈雪。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: snow was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, prayers were offered for snow.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兗州仙源縣生瑞穀。

translations.literal: That year, lucky grain grew in Xianyuan county, Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yanzhou’s Xianyuan county had lucky grain.

sentences.zh: 高麗、占城、西南蕃龍氏、羅氏入貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo, Champa, and the southwestern Dragon and Luo tribes came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo, Champa, and southwestern Dragon and Luo tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月己卯朔，不受朝。

translations.literal: Year eight, spring, first month, day jimao, new moon: he did not receive audience.
translations.idiomatic: Year eight, first month, jimao new moon: no New Year audience was held.

sentences.zh: 甲申，蔡確卒。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Cai Que died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Cai Que died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，御邇英閣，召宰臣讀《寶訓》。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: at Eyrie Hall he summoned the chief ministers to read the Imperial Instructions.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, chief ministers read the Imperial Instructions at Eyrie Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔復範純仁太中大夫。

translations.literal: Day gengyin, edict: Fan Chunren was restored to Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Fan Chunren was restored to Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，幸太乙宮。

translations.literal: Day renchen: he visited the Great Unity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he visited the Great Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔頒高麗所獻《黃帝針經》於天下。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: the Yellow Emperor’s Needle Classic presented by Goryeo was to be issued throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Goryeo’s Yellow Emperor’s Needle Classic was ordered published empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，詔西南蕃龍氏遷秩補官。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou, edict: the southwestern Dragon tribe were to receive migration ranks and official appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiyou: southwestern Dragon clansmen were promoted and appointed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，禮部尚書蘇軾言：「高麗使乞買歷代史及《策府元龜》等書，宜卻其請不許。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Minister of Rites Su Shi said: “The Goryeo envoys ask to buy dynastic histories and works such as the Cefu Yuangui; the request should be refused and not allowed.”
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Su Shi of the Ministry of Rites urged refusal when Goryeo asked to buy dynastic histories and the Cefu Yuangui.

sentences.zh: 」省臣許之，軾又疏陳五害，極論其不可。

translations.literal: The councilors approved; Su Shi again memorialized, setting forth five harms and arguing the matter could not be allowed.
translations.idiomatic: The council approved, but Su Shi memorialized again with five harms and pressed for a ban.

sentences.zh: 有旨：「書籍曾經買者聽。

translations.literal: Imperial intent: “Books they had already bought may be allowed.”
translations.idiomatic: The throne ruled: “Books already purchased may be allowed.”

sentences.zh: 」壬子，詔刑部不得分禁系人數，瘐死數多者申尚書省。

translations.literal: Day renzi, edict: the Ministry of Justice was not to divide up the number of confined prisoners; where many died in custody, report was to be made to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Ministry of Justice was told not to split prisoner counts and to report many custody deaths to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔大寧郡王以下出就外學。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: the Great Tranquility Prince and below were to attend the outer school.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Great Tranquility Prince and younger princes were sent to the outer school.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，蘇頌罷。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen: Su Song left office.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiashen: Su Song stepped down.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，範百祿罷。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Fan Bailu left office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Fan Bailu stepped down.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔御試舉人復試賦、詩、論三題。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: palace-examination candidates were again to be tested on fu, shi, and lun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, palace examinees were again tested on fu, shi, and lun.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未朔，夏人來謝罪，願以蘭州易塞門砦，不許。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingwei, new moon: Xia came to apologize and asked to trade Lanzhou for Saimen stockade; it was not allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingwei new moon: Xia apologized and sought Lanzhou for Saimen stockade—in vain.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔恤刑。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: merciful review of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, a merciful criminal review was ordered.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，令范祖禹依先朝故事止兼侍講。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Fan Zuyu was ordered, according to former precedent, to hold only a concurrent attending exposition post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Fan Zuyu was limited to a concurrent exposition post, as before.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔南郊合祭天地，罷禮部集官詳議。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: at the southern suburb Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to; the Ministry of Rites gathering officials for detailed discussion was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, joint Heaven-and-Earth sacrifice at the southern suburb was ordered and further ritual debate ended.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，置蘄州羅田縣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiwei: Luotian county in Qizhou was established.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guiwei: Luotian county was created in Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，罷二廣鑄折二錢。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the two Guang regions’ casting of fold-two coins was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the two Guang regions stopped casting fold-two coins.

sentences.zh: 己丑，錄囚。

translations.literal: Day jichou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，監察御史董敦逸、黃慶基以論蘇軾、蘇轍，罷爲湖北、福建轉運判官。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: remonstrance censors Dong Dunyi and Huang Qingji, for criticizing Su Shi and Su Zhe, were demoted to Hubei and Fujian transport vice commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Dong Dunyi and Huang Qingji were sent to Hubei and Fujian transport for attacking the Su brothers.

sentences.zh: 己亥，祁國公亻思爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Duke Si of Qi was made Palace Opener of the Same Rank as the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Duke Si of Qi became Palace Opener of Same Rank Three.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，梁燾罷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: Liang Tao left office.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuwu: Liang Tao stepped down.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，中書後省上《元祐在京通用條貫》。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the Central Secretariat rear office submitted the Yuanyou Capital General Regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the rear secretariat submitted the Yuanyou Capital General Regulations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子朔，以觀文殿大學士范純仁爲尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingzi, new moon: Exalted Culture Hall academician Fan Chunren was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Central Secretariat Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingzi new moon: Fan Chunren joined the council as right vice director.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，令陝西沿邊鐵錢、銅錢悉還近地。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Shaanxi along the border was ordered to return all iron and copper cash to nearby areas.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Shaanxi border iron and copper cash were recalled to nearby districts.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，久雨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei: long rain.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingwei: prolonged rain.

sentences.zh: 禱山川。

translations.literal: Prayers were offered at the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Prayers were offered at mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，乙太皇太后疾，帝不視事。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: because the Grand Empress Dowager was ill, the emperor ceased handling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill and the emperor stopped governing.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣使按視京東西、河南北、淮南水災。

translations.literal: Day renxu: envoys were sent to inspect flood damage in the Eastern and Western Capital circuits, Henan north and south, and Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, envoys inspected floods in the capital circuits, Henan, and Huainan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，減京師囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day guihai: crimes of capital prisoners were reduced one degree; those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, capital prisoners were commuted and lesser offenders freed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，禱于岳瀆、宮觀、祠廟。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: prayers were offered at the sacred mountains and rivers, palaces, temples, and shrines.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, prayers went out to sacred peaks, rivers, palaces, temples, and shrines.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: all under Heaven was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔陝西復鑄小銅錢。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: Shaanxi was again to cast small copper coins.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Shaanxi was told to resume casting small copper cash.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禱於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: prayers were offered at Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, he prayed at Heaven, Earth, temples, and altars.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，禱于諸陵。

translations.literal: Day yihai: prayers were offered at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, he prayed at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，太皇太后崩。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuyin: the Grand Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuyin: the Grand Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔乙太皇太后園陵爲山陵。

translations.literal: Day jimao, edict: the Grand Empress Dowager’s garden tomb was renamed a mountain tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, her garden tomb was redesignated a mountain tomb.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣使告哀於遼。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, envoys announced her death to Liao.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命呂大防爲山陵使。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Lü Dafang was appointed mountain-tomb commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Lü Dafang was named mountain-tomb commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔山陵修奉從約，諸道毋妄有進助。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: mountain-tomb maintenance was to be kept frugal; circuits were not rashly to send contributions.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, tomb works were ordered kept frugal and circuits told not to send gifts.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，群臣七上表請聽政。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wushen: the ministers memorialized seven times asking him to hear government.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wushen: ministers pleaded seven times for him to resume rule.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，徐王顥乞解官給喪，詔不允。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Prince Xu Hao begged to resign office and observe mourning; the edict did not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Prince Xu Hao asked to leave office for mourning and was refused.

sentences.zh: 庚午，復內侍劉瑗等六人。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: six inner attendants including Liu Yuan were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, six eunuchs including Liu Yuan were restored.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，始御垂拱殿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: he first held audience at the Drooping Bow Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingzi: he reopened court at Drooping Bow Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以雪寒，振京城民饑。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: because of snow and cold, famine relief was given to the capital populace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, snow and cold brought famine relief to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜勞修奉山陵兵士。

translations.literal: Day renyin: soldiers repairing the mountain tomb were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, tomb-repair troops were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，範純仁乞罷，不允。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi: Fan Chunren begged to leave office; it was not allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yisi: Fan Chunren’s resignation was refused.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，仿《唐六典》修官制。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the official system was revised modeled on the Tang Six Codes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, offices were reorganized on the model of the Tang Six Codes.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遼人遣使來弔祭。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Liao sent envoys to offer condolence sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Liao envoys came to mourn.

sentences.zh: 出錢粟十萬振流民。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand in cash and grain was disbursed to relieve displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred thousand in cash and grain went to relieve migrants.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上太皇太后諡曰宣仁聖烈皇后。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Grand Empress Dowager’s posthumous title was set as Empress Xuanren the Holy and Liege.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, she was posthumously titled Empress Xuanren the Holy and Liege.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河入德清軍，決內黃口。

translations.literal: That year the Yellow River entered Deqing army and breached at the Neihuang mouth.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yellow River poured into Deqing army and broke at Neihuang.
